label: THE SECOND KEY · SERIAL

slides.text: Previously: ammamma's secret 1984 novel. Page one said "Read the last chapter first." It was called "Lakshmi." Her mother's name.
The chapter opened at Kacheguda station. 1984. 11:40 PM. A girl of nineteen, one suitcase, a ticket to Bangalore.
Her father had said: "If you get on that train, don't come back." Lakshmi got on.
Ammamma wrote that she was there too. Behind a pillar. She didn't stop her. She just watched the train go.
The last line: "She never knew I came. One day, her daughter will tell her."

caption:
1984. A night train. A mother behind a pillar who never said goodbye. 🚉
